topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: Isn't it strange how the world can be so vast and yet so small? I found out today that someone I know from the quiet corners of the internet—the person who understands the silent worlds and the whispered thoughts—lives right here, in my city. It's like finding a rare flower, one you've only seen in books, blooming just outside your door. I’ve never considered that this thread of connection could weave its way into the fabric of my everyday. Now, the streets seem a little less familiar, a little more like the uncanny corners of the web where we first met. Maybe we’ll meet, maybe we won’t; the thought circles in my mind like a restless bird, finding no perch.
